blocks.zh: 學習目標 (Learning Objectives)
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 C&Q Plan（確效與委試計畫） 的目的、效益，以及在整體專案生命週期中的角色與位置。
blocks.en: Understand the purpose and benefits of the C&Q Plan (Commissioning and Qualification Plan) and its role and position within the overall project life cycle.

blocks.zh: 掌握 C&Q Plan 的審批時序規則（計畫 → 測試指令 → 執行），並了解為何此順序在業界常被違反。
blocks.en: Master the approval sequence rule for the C&Q Plan (plan → test instructions → execution), and understand why this order is so often violated in industry.

blocks.zh: 了解 C&Q Plan 的核心內容要素：範疇、策略、文件管理、測試描述，以及差異處理程序。
blocks.en: Understand the core content elements of the C&Q Plan: scope, strategy, document management, test descriptions, and discrepancy handling procedures.

blocks.zh: 熟悉 Table 6.1 核准矩陣的架構與使用方式，包括事前審批者（Pre-Approver）與事後審批者（Post-Approver）的區別。
blocks.en: Become familiar with the structure and use of the Table 6.1 approval matrix, including the difference between Pre-Approvers and Post-Approvers.

blocks.zh: 將 C&Q Planning 的原則應用於 CDMO 實務場景，例如新充填線安裝或公用系統擴建專案。
blocks.en: Apply the principles of C&Q Planning to CDMO scenarios, such as a new filling line installation or a utility expansion project.

blocks.zh: 本章節目錄
blocks.en: Chapter Contents

blocks.zh: 中文解說 Commentary
blocks.en: Commentary

blocks.zh: C&Q 的本質：有計畫的工程活動
blocks.en: The Nature of C&Q: A Planned Engineering Activity

blocks.zh: ISPE 強調 C&Q（Commissioning and Qualification，委試與確效）不是一個「做完測試就結束」的程序，而是一個有計畫、有文件、有管理的工程活動，從 URS 寫好的那一天起，一直延伸到系統正式接收釋放為止。
blocks.en: ISPE stresses that C&Q (Commissioning and Qualification) is not a process that ends once the testing is done. It is a planned, documented, and managed engineering activity that runs from the day the URS is written until the system is formally accepted and released.

blocks.zh: 這個視角很重要：它把 C&Q 定位為工程專案的一部份，而不是質量部門在最後補做的文書工作。
blocks.en: This perspective matters: it positions C&Q as part of the engineering project, rather than paperwork the quality unit scrambles to complete at the end.

blocks.zh: 比喻：蓋房子的施工計畫
blocks.en: Analogy: A Construction Plan for Building a House

blocks.zh: C&Q Planning 就像建設公司在動工前要先做的「施工計畫書」。
blocks.en: C&Q Planning is like the construction plan a building contractor must prepare before breaking ground.

blocks.zh: 你不能邊做邊想：「今天澆混凝土，明天再決定要不要驗收」。每一道工序都要排程、明確誰負責、何時完成、驗收標準是什麼。
blocks.en: You cannot work it out as you go: "We pour concrete today and decide tomorrow whether to inspect it." Every work step must be scheduled, with clear ownership, a completion date, and acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 就是那份施工計畫書，確保整個團隊（工程、品保、生產、廠商）都照同一份劇本走。
blocks.en: The C&Q Plan is that construction plan. It makes sure the whole team (engineering, QA, production, vendors) works from the same script.

blocks.zh: 注意：本章聚焦正式 C&Q Plan
blocks.en: Note: This Chapter Focuses on the Formal C&Q Plan

blocks.zh: 書中提醒讀者，還有很多其他計畫（例如清潔計畫、整體專案計畫），但本章只討論正式的 C&Q Plan。其他計畫請參考 Chapter 21（Appendix 7）。
blocks.en: The book reminds readers that many other plans exist (for example, cleaning plans and overall project plans), but this chapter covers only the formal C&Q Plan. For other plans, see Chapter 21 (Appendix 7).

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 的三大效益
blocks.en: The Three Main Benefits of a C&Q Plan

blocks.zh: 跨部門溝通橋樑：讓品保、廠商、生產、自動化、工程、施工等不同團隊，有共同遵循的計畫文件
blocks.en: A communication bridge across functions: gives QA, vendors, production, automation, engineering, and construction a common plan document to follow

blocks.zh: 跨學科團隊整合：打破部門壁壘，建立一個整合性的 C&Q 專案團隊
blocks.en: Integration of cross-disciplinary teams: breaks down departmental walls and builds one integrated C&Q project team

blocks.zh: 利害關係人期望管理：準時交付、符合預算、符合預期用途、確保產品品質
blocks.en: Management of stakeholder expectations: on-time delivery, within budget, fit for intended use, and assured product quality

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：Critical Path Method（關鍵路徑法）
blocks.en: Key Term: Critical Path Method (CPM)

blocks.zh: CPM 是專案管理中常用的排程技術。它找出專案中最長的依賴活動鏈，這條鏈上任何一個活動的延遲，都會直接導致整個專案延遲。
blocks.en: CPM is a scheduling technique widely used in project management. It identifies the longest chain of dependent activities in a project; a delay in any activity on this chain directly delays the whole project.

blocks.zh: 在 C&Q 中的意義：例如，HVAC 調試必須在無菌充填區 IQ 之前完成；IQ 完成才能做 OQ；OQ 完成才能做 PQ。這條鏈就是關鍵路徑。提早辨識它，才能及早採購長交期設備、安排人力資源。
blocks.en: What it means in C&Q: for example, HVAC commissioning must be completed before IQ of the aseptic filling area; IQ must be completed before OQ; and OQ before PQ. This chain is the critical path. Identifying it early lets you order long-lead equipment and arrange resources in time.

blocks.zh: 比喻：排程失控的後果
blocks.en: Analogy: The Consequence of an Uncontrolled Schedule

blocks.zh: 想像一條填充線安裝專案，業主希望 10 月開始 PQ，但沒有人提前排好關鍵路徑：結果 8 月才發現水系統的 EP（認可廠商評估）還沒做，設備還沒到廠，OQ 就不能開始。
blocks.en: Imagine a filling line installation project where the owner wants PQ to start in October, but nobody mapped out the critical path in advance. In August it turns out that the approved-vendor evaluation (EP) for the water system has not been done and the equipment has not arrived, so OQ cannot start.

blocks.zh: Critical Path Method 的目的，就是讓這種「到最後才發現問題」的狀況，在計畫階段就被發現和處理。
blocks.en: The purpose of the Critical Path Method is to make sure that this kind of "discovered at the last minute" problem is found and dealt with at the planning stage.

blocks.zh: 重點：排程更新 ≠ 計畫修訂
blocks.en: Key Point: A Schedule Update Is Not a Plan Revision

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別指出：定期更新排程是正常的，但排程更新不應觸發 C&Q Plan 的版本修訂。C&Q Plan 應說明排程更新如何被紀錄與傳達，而非每次更新排程就重新審批計畫。這是很實用的操作建議。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically points out that regular schedule updates are normal, but a schedule update should not trigger a revision of the C&Q Plan. The C&Q Plan should describe how schedule updates are recorded and communicated, rather than re-approving the plan every time the schedule changes. This is very practical advice.

blocks.zh: 計畫深度應與專案規模成比例
blocks.en: Plan Depth Should Be Proportionate to Project Size

blocks.zh: ISPE 採取風險比例原則（risk-proportionate approach）：計畫的詳盡程度取決於：
blocks.en: ISPE takes a risk-proportionate approach: the level of detail in the plan depends on:

blocks.zh: 組織/廠址的期望（公司內規）
blocks.en: The expectations of the organization/site (company policy)

blocks.zh: 系統或專案的大小與複雜度
blocks.en: The size and complexity of the system or project

blocks.zh: 對產品品質和病患安全的潛在影響
blocks.en: The potential impact on product quality and patient safety

blocks.zh: 什麼情況需要獨立的 C&Q Plan？
blocks.en: When Is a Standalone C&Q Plan Needed?

blocks.zh:
不需要獨立計畫（納入變更管制即可）：
新增一台小型輔助設備（例如，更換一台蠕動泵）
blocks.en:
No standalone plan needed (change control is sufficient):
Adding a small piece of auxiliary equipment (for example, replacing a peristaltic pump)

blocks.zh: 需要獨立 C&Q Plan：
blocks.en: Standalone C&Q Plan needed:

blocks.zh: 新安裝含最終滅菌和二次包裝的充填線
blocks.en: A new filling line installation including terminal sterilization and secondary packaging

blocks.zh: 廠址產能倍增，含公用系統擴建（WFI、純蒸汽、潔淨空調）
blocks.en: A site capacity doubling that includes utility expansion (WFI, pure steam, clean HVAC)

blocks.zh: 判斷標準：專案越複雜、影響越大，越需要一份獨立的正式計畫文件來統籌管理。
blocks.en: Rule of thumb: the more complex the project and the greater its impact, the more it needs a standalone formal plan document to coordinate it.

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 不應重複其他文件
blocks.en: The C&Q Plan Should Not Duplicate Other Documents

blocks.zh: 計畫的功能是「組織文件架構」，而非「複製文件內容」。它告訴讀者「哪個文件在哪裡、誰負責、什麼時候要完成」，而不是把 URS 或 SRA 的內容再抄一遍。
blocks.en: The plan's function is to "organize the document structure", not to "copy document content". It tells the reader which document is where, who is responsible, and when it is due, rather than re-transcribing the contents of the URS or SRA.

blocks.zh: 審批時序規則（業界最常被違反的規定之一）
blocks.en: Approval Sequence Rule (One of the Rules Most Often Violated in Industry)

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確規定了三個必須依序進行的審批步驟：
blocks.en: ISPE clearly specifies three approval steps that must happen in order:

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 審批完成（計畫核准）
blocks.en: C&Q Plan approval completed (plan approved)

blocks.zh: 測試指令（Test Instructions）審批完成（IQ/OQ/PQ Protocol 核准）
blocks.en: Test Instructions approval completed (IQ/OQ/PQ protocols approved)

blocks.zh: 開始執行測試
blocks.en: Test execution begins

blocks.zh: 這個序列不能顛倒，更不能跳過。
blocks.en: This sequence cannot be reversed, and certainly not skipped.

blocks.zh: 為什麼業界常違反這個規則？
blocks.en: Why Does Industry Often Violate This Rule?

blocks.zh: 在實際 CDMO 或設備安裝專案中，常見情況：
blocks.en: In real CDMO or equipment installation projects, common situations include:

blocks.zh: 設備到廠了，工程師急著「先跑一下 IQ」，Protocol 還在品保審批中
blocks.en: The equipment has arrived and engineers are eager to "just run the IQ first" while the protocol is still in QA approval

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 還沒最終核准，但委試工程師已開始 FAT
blocks.en: The C&Q Plan has not been finally approved, but commissioning engineers have already started FAT

blocks.zh: 為了趕上 Launch 時程，OQ 執行完才補做 Protocol 審批
blocks.en: To meet the launch schedule, the protocol is approved only after OQ has been executed

blocks.zh: 這些行為在法規稽查時，都可能被認定為程序不合規（Protocol not approved prior to execution）。一旦被 FDA 483 或 Warning Letter 點名，補救成本遠大於當初多等幾天審批的時間。
blocks.en: In a regulatory inspection, these behaviors can all be judged procedural non-compliance (protocol not approved prior to execution). Once cited in an FDA 483 or Warning Letter, the cost of remediation is far greater than the few days of waiting for approval would have been.

blocks.zh: 計畫應從概念階段或基本工程初期開始
blocks.en: Planning Should Begin in the Concept Phase or Early Basic Engineering

blocks.zh: C&Q 計畫不是在設備到廠前幾週才開始寫的文件。ISPE 建議在概念階段（Concept Phase）或基本工程初期（Early Basic Engineering）就開始規劃。
blocks.en: The C&Q plan is not a document to be written only a few weeks before the equipment arrives. ISPE recommends starting to plan in the Concept Phase or Early Basic Engineering.

blocks.zh: 這是因為：URS 的品質要求、系統分類結果、SRA 的 CDE 辨識，都必須在計畫階段就確定，才能定義測試的範疇與接受標準。
blocks.en: This is because the quality requirements in the URS, the system classification results, and the CDE identification from the SRA must all be settled at the planning stage before the scope and acceptance criteria of testing can be defined.

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 是活文件（Living Document）
blocks.en: The C&Q Plan Is a Living Document

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 不是寫完就鎖起來的文件。隨著專案進展，當設計變更、範疇調整、新的 CDE 被辨識時，計畫需要相應更新。
blocks.en: The C&Q Plan is not a document that is written and then locked away. As the project progresses, the plan must be updated accordingly when design changes occur, the scope is adjusted, or new CDEs are identified.

blocks.zh: 版本修訂原則：
blocks.en: Principles for revising the version:

blocks.zh: 有重大變更 → 啟動正式版本修訂，由原核准者（或其代理人）審批
blocks.en: Significant change → initiate a formal version revision, approved by the original approvers (or their delegates)

blocks.zh: 輕微偏離 → 可記錄在 Qualification Summary Report（確效總結報告）中，加上理由說明，不一定要重改計畫
blocks.en: Minor deviation → may be recorded in the Qualification Summary Report with a justification, without necessarily revising the plan

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：Qualification Summary Report（確效總結報告）
blocks.en: Key Term: Qualification Summary Report

blocks.zh: 確效總結報告是在整個確效活動完成後，彙整所有測試結果、偏差處理、執行摘要的最終報告文件。
blocks.en: The Qualification Summary Report is the final report that, once all qualification activities are complete, consolidates all test results, deviation handling, and an execution summary.

blocks.zh: ISPE 允許將輕微偏離 C&Q Plan 的情況記錄在這份報告中（加上說明），而不需要每次都修訂 C&Q Plan。這是一個務實的彈性規定。
blocks.en: ISPE allows minor deviations from the C&Q Plan to be recorded in this report (with an explanation), so the C&Q Plan need not be revised each time. This is a pragmatic and flexible provision.

blocks.zh: 計畫變更須走變更管理
blocks.en: Plan Changes Must Go Through Change Management

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 的任何修訂都應透過變更管理（Change Management，Chapter 12）處理，以確保變更對 C&Q 工作的影響被適當評估和記錄。
blocks.en: Any revision of the C&Q Plan should be handled through Change Management (Chapter 12), to ensure the impact of the change on C&Q work is properly assessed and documented.

blocks.zh: 這防止了「私下改計畫卻沒通知品保」的情形發生。
blocks.en: This prevents the situation in which the plan is quietly changed without notifying QA.

blocks.zh: 測試範疇的決定邏輯
blocks.en: Logic for Determining the Scope of Testing

blocks.zh: 測試範疇（Scope of Testing）由以下文件決定：
blocks.en: The Scope of Testing is determined by the following documents:

blocks.zh: 系統分類（System Classification） → 決定哪些系統需要確效（直接影響 vs 非直接影響）
blocks.en: System Classification → determines which systems need qualification (direct impact vs not direct impact)

blocks.zh: 系統風險評估（System Risk Assessment, SRA） → 決定系統中哪些元素需要確效（CDE 的辨識）
blocks.en: System Risk Assessment (SRA) → determines which elements of the system need qualification (identification of CDEs)

blocks.zh: URS + SRA → 共同建立確效測試的範疇
blocks.en: URS + SRA → together establish the scope of qualification testing

blocks.zh: 設備規格 → 決定委試（Commissioning）的測試範疇
blocks.en: Equipment specifications → determine the scope of commissioning testing

blocks.zh: 文件來源決策（Document Source）
blocks.en: Document Source Decision

blocks.zh: 規劃階段必須決定：FAT、SAT、或委試文件是否可以用來支援確效結論？
blocks.en: At the planning stage you must decide: can FAT, SAT, or commissioning documents be used to support qualification conclusions?

blocks.zh: 這個決定的依據是：
blocks.en: The basis for this decision is:

blocks.zh: 廠商評估（Vendor Assessment）的結果 → 廠商文件品質是否足夠？
blocks.en: The result of the Vendor Assessment → is the quality of the vendor's documentation sufficient?

blocks.zh: 測試的關鍵性 → 是否涉及 CDE？
blocks.en: The criticality of the test → does it involve a CDE?

blocks.zh: 目的是減少重複測試（minimize retesting）。如果 FAT 已有充分記錄，就不需要到廠再做一次相同測試。
blocks.en: The aim is to minimize retesting. If the FAT is already well documented, there is no need to repeat the same test on site.

blocks.zh: 文件不需要完美無缺
blocks.en: Documentation Does Not Need to Be Perfect

blocks.zh: ISPE 明確指出：「Pristine documentation is NOT essential.」 文件允許有更正記錄，重點是易於閱讀和理解。這是一個務實的立場，避免因過度追求「無更正文件」而浪費資源，或更糟糕地：將更正直接消除而非正式記錄。
blocks.en: ISPE states plainly: "Pristine documentation is NOT essential." Documents may contain recorded corrections; what matters is that they are easy to read and understand. This is a pragmatic position that avoids wasting resources in pursuit of "correction-free documents" or, worse, eliminating corrections rather than recording them formally.

blocks.zh: 與整體 Project Execution Plan（PEP）的協調
blocks.en: Coordination with the Overall Project Execution Plan (PEP)

blocks.zh: C&Q 活動必須整合進整體 PEP（專案執行計畫），這樣才能：
blocks.en: C&Q activities must be integrated into the overall PEP (Project Execution Plan), so that you can:

blocks.zh: 識別 C&Q 活動與建設、採購、操作之間的相依性（interdependencies）
blocks.en: Identify the interdependencies between C&Q activities and construction, procurement, and operations

blocks.zh: 合理排序多系統的測試順序（先供電，才能啟動）
blocks.en: Sequence the testing of multiple systems sensibly (power must be available before startup)

blocks.zh: 為品保文件審查排出時間窗口（QA review cycle）
blocks.en: Schedule time windows for QA document review (QA review cycle)

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務上，這意味著 C&Q 計畫工程師需要參加 PEP 的排程會議，而不是單獨在品保部門內部討論。
blocks.en: In CDMO practice, this means the C&Q planning engineer needs to attend PEP scheduling meetings, rather than discussing matters only within the QA department.

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 的典型內容架構
blocks.en: Typical Content Structure of a C&Q Plan

blocks.zh: 一份完整的 C&Q Plan 應包含以下主要元素：
blocks.en: A complete C&Q Plan should include the following main elements:

blocks.zh: 計畫範疇（系統清單）
blocks.en: Scope of the plan (list of systems)

blocks.zh: 執行策略與方法
blocks.en: Execution strategy and approach

blocks.zh: 各系統的文件需求清單（URS、FAT、SAT、IQ/OQ/PQ、SOP）
blocks.en: Document requirements list for each system (URS, FAT, SAT, IQ/OQ/PQ, SOPs)

blocks.zh: 角色與責任（含核准矩陣）
blocks.en: Roles and responsibilities (including the approval matrix)

blocks.zh: 文件範本參考
blocks.en: References to document templates

blocks.zh: 計畫中的檢查與測試（含驗收標準、負責 SME、測試程序參考）
blocks.en: Checks and tests in the plan (including acceptance criteria, responsible SME, and test procedure references)

blocks.zh: CDMO 應用：新充填線 C&Q Plan 範例架構
blocks.en: CDMO Application: Example C&Q Plan Structure for a New Filling Line

blocks.zh: 以 CDMO 承接新無菌充填線安裝專案為例，C&Q Plan 可能包含：
blocks.en: Taking a CDMO undertaking the installation of a new aseptic filling line as an example, the C&Q Plan might include:

blocks.zh: 範疇：充填機、凍乾機、去熱原烘箱、CIP/SIP 系統、隔離器（直接影響）；HVAC、純水系統、壓縮空氣（直接影響）；冷卻水（非直接影響）
blocks.en: Scope: filling machine, freeze dryer, depyrogenation oven, CIP/SIP system, isolator (direct impact); HVAC, purified water system, compressed air (direct impact); chilled water (not direct impact)

blocks.zh: 策略：凍乾機採 FAT（在廠商場地）+ SAT + IQ/OQ/PQ；充填機採廠商 FAT + 現場 IQ/OQ/PQ
blocks.en: Strategy: freeze dryer uses FAT (at the vendor's site) + SAT + IQ/OQ/PQ; filling machine uses vendor FAT + on-site IQ/OQ/PQ

blocks.zh: 文件矩陣：列出每個系統的文件清單、負責部門、預計完成日期
blocks.en: Document matrix: lists the documents for each system, the responsible department, and the expected completion date

blocks.zh: 核准矩陣：依 Table 6.1 格式，明確每份文件的事前/事後核准者
blocks.en: Approval matrix: following the Table 6.1 format, clearly identifies the pre-approvers and post-approvers for each document

blocks.zh: CDE 的接受標準可延伸到個別測試指令
blocks.en: CDE Acceptance Criteria Can Be Deferred to Individual Test Instructions

blocks.zh: 計畫中對 CDE 測試的接受標準，可以「轉引」（defer）至個別的測試指令（test instructions）中定義，不一定要在 C&Q Plan 中一一列明。這給了實際操作上的彈性。
blocks.en: The acceptance criteria for CDE tests in the plan can be deferred to the individual test instructions, rather than being listed one by one in the C&Q Plan. This gives flexibility in practical operation.

blocks.zh: 範疇包含直接與非直接影響系統
blocks.en: Scope Includes Both Direct Impact and Not Direct Impact Systems

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 的範疇不能只列直接影響（Direct Impact）系統。非直接影響（Not Direct Impact）的系統（如冷卻水、普通壓縮空氣）雖然不需要正式確效，但仍在 C&Q 計畫的管理範圍內，需要委試（Commissioning）。
blocks.en: The scope of the C&Q Plan cannot list only Direct Impact systems. Not Direct Impact systems (such as chilled water and general compressed air) do not require formal qualification, but they still fall within the management scope of the C&Q plan and need commissioning.

blocks.zh: PQ 活動可納入 C&Q Plan
blocks.en: PQ Activities May Be Included in the C&Q Plan

blocks.zh: 以下項目的 PQ（Performance Qualification，性能確效）可以（但不強制）納入 C&Q Plan 管理：
blocks.en: The PQ (Performance Qualification) of the following items may (but need not) be managed within the C&Q Plan:

blocks.zh: 藥品級公用系統：WFI（注射用水）、純水（PW）
blocks.en: Pharmaceutical-grade utilities: WFI (water for injection), purified water (PW)

blocks.zh: 支援系統：高壓滅菌器、去熱原烘箱、清洗機
blocks.en: Support systems: autoclaves, depyrogenation ovens, washers

blocks.zh: 環境：無菌室的環境確認（非環境監控）
blocks.en: Environment: environmental qualification of the aseptic room (not environmental monitoring)

blocks.zh: 非產品 PQ：無菌模擬充填（Media Fill）
blocks.en: Non-product PQ: aseptic process simulation (media fill)

blocks.zh: 各廠址需自行決定這些是否納入 C&Q 計畫，或另立獨立驗證計畫（Validation Program）。
blocks.en: Each site must decide for itself whether to include these in the C&Q plan or to set up a separate Validation Program.

blocks.zh: 周期開發應在最終確效測試之前完成
blocks.en: Cycle Development Should Be Completed Before Final Qualification Testing

blocks.zh: ISPE 特別建議：不要在 Cycle Development（周期開發）完成之前就進行最終確效測試。因為周期開發（如滅菌周期、清潔周期）可能發現需要修改設計的問題。若先做確效再改設計，就必須重做確效，成本很高。
blocks.en: ISPE specifically recommends: do not carry out final qualification testing before Cycle Development is complete. Cycle development (such as sterilization cycles and cleaning cycles) may uncover problems that require design changes. If qualification is done first and the design is changed afterwards, the qualification must be repeated, which is very costly.

blocks.zh: 正確順序：Cycle Development → 確認無設計變更 → 最終 IQ/OQ/PQ
blocks.en: Correct sequence: Cycle Development → confirm no design changes → final IQ/OQ/PQ

blocks.zh: 策略決策：只做委試，還是委試＋確效？
blocks.en: Strategy Decision: Commissioning Only, or Commissioning Plus Qualification?

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 必須明確定義每個系統的策略：
blocks.en: The C&Q Plan must clearly define the strategy for each system:

blocks.zh: Commissioned Only（僅委試）：適用於非直接影響系統（如冷卻水、普通電力）
blocks.en: Commissioned Only: applies to not direct impact systems (such as chilled water and general power)

blocks.zh: Commissioned + Qualified（委試＋確效）：適用於直接影響系統（如無菌充填線、WFI 系統）
blocks.en: Commissioned + Qualified: applies to direct impact systems (such as the aseptic filling line and the WFI system)

blocks.zh: 決定依據：系統分類（Chapter 3）＋ SRA 的 CDE 辨識結果。
blocks.en: Basis for the decision: system classification (Chapter 3) + the CDE identification results of the SRA.

blocks.zh: 確效嚴格度取決於多項因素
blocks.en: Rigor of Qualification Depends on Several Factors

blocks.zh: 測試的嚴格程度（rigor of testing）受以下因素影響：
blocks.en: The rigor of testing is influenced by the following factors:

blocks.zh: 使用者需求（URS 的要求）
blocks.en: User requirements (the requirements in the URS)

blocks.zh: CDEs 的數量和關鍵性
blocks.en: The number and criticality of CDEs

blocks.zh: 系統特性（套裝系統 vs 模組化 vs 現場安裝）
blocks.en: System characteristics (packaged system vs modular vs field-installed)

blocks.zh: 與廠商的過往合作經驗（有認可的廠商，文件可更多採用）
blocks.en: Prior experience working with the vendor (with an approved vendor, more of the documentation can be leveraged)

blocks.zh: 廠商文件使用標準：提前在計畫中定義
blocks.en: Standards for Using Vendor Documents: Define Them in the Plan in Advance

blocks.zh: 如果計畫採用廠商文件（如 FAT 報告、廠商 IQ）來支援確效結論，必須在計畫中預先定義使用標準，例如：
blocks.en: If the plan uses vendor documents (such as FAT reports or vendor IQ) to support qualification conclusions, the standards for their use must be defined in the plan beforehand, for example:

blocks.zh: 廠商文件須由 SME 事前審批（pre-approval）
blocks.en: Vendor documents must be pre-approved by an SME

blocks.zh: 廠商評估報告（Vendor Assessment）需達到什麼標準才能採用其文件
blocks.en: What standard the Vendor Assessment report must meet before the vendor's documents can be used

blocks.zh: 接受哪種程度的廠商資質（Audit 結果、ISO 認證等）
blocks.en: What level of vendor credentials is accepted (audit results, ISO certification, etc.)

blocks.zh: 這些標準必須在計畫中寫明，而非事後補救。
blocks.en: These standards must be written into the plan, not remedied afterwards.

blocks.zh: 測試依賴性（Dependencies）必須明確記錄
blocks.en: Test Dependencies Must Be Clearly Documented

blocks.zh: 例如：HVAC 系統的 OQ 必須在無菌室壓差和換氣次數確認之後，充填線的 IQ 才能開始。這種依賴關係必須在 C&Q Plan 中明確記載，以支援正確的測試排序。
blocks.en: For example, the OQ of the HVAC system must be completed, with the pressure differentials and air change rates of the aseptic room confirmed, before IQ of the filling line can begin. Such dependencies must be clearly recorded in the C&Q Plan to support correct test sequencing.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：Document Matrix（文件矩陣）
blocks.en: Key Term: Document Matrix

blocks.zh: Document Matrix（文件矩陣）是一份表格，列出專案中所有需要的文件，以及每份文件的：
blocks.en: The Document Matrix is a table that lists all the documents required in the project and, for each document:

blocks.zh: 負責編寫部門/人員
blocks.en: The department/person responsible for writing it

blocks.zh: 審批者（含事前/事後）
blocks.en: Approvers (including pre-approval/post-approval)

blocks.zh: 預計完成日期
blocks.en: Expected completion date

blocks.zh: 文件狀態追蹤
blocks.en: Document status tracking

blocks.zh: 它是 C&Q Plan 中最實用的工具之一，讓專案經理能一眼掌握所有文件的進度。
blocks.en: It is one of the most practical tools in the C&Q Plan, allowing the project manager to see the progress of all documents at a glance.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：Turnover Package（移交文件包）
blocks.en: Key Term: Turnover Package

blocks.zh: Turnover Package（TOP）是施工或安裝完成後，由承包商/廠商移交給業主的文件集合，通常包含：
blocks.en: The Turnover Package (TOP) is the set of documents handed over by the contractor/vendor to the owner after construction or installation is complete, and usually includes:

blocks.zh: As-built 竣工圖
blocks.en: As-built drawings

blocks.zh: 材質証書（Material Certificates）
blocks.en: Material Certificates

blocks.zh: 焊接記錄（Weld Records）
blocks.en: Weld Records

blocks.zh: 設備手冊（User Manuals）
blocks.en: User Manuals

blocks.zh: 校正記錄（Calibration Records）
blocks.en: Calibration Records

blocks.zh: 測試報告（FAT/SAT Reports）
blocks.en: Test reports (FAT/SAT Reports)

blocks.zh: TOP 是 IQ（安裝確效）的重要輸入文件，必須在確效開始前完成並通過審查。
blocks.en: The TOP is an important input to IQ (installation qualification) and must be completed and reviewed before qualification begins.

blocks.zh: 15 類需追蹤的文件
blocks.en: 15 Categories of Documents to Track

blocks.zh: ISPE 列出的追蹤清單涵蓋了整個 C&Q 生命週期的文件類型，從設計前的 URS 到最後的 Project Reports，確保沒有任何文件被遺漏。
blocks.en: The tracking list ISPE provides covers the document types across the entire C&Q life cycle, from the URS before design through to the final Project Reports, to make sure no document is missed.

blocks.zh: 特別值得注意的是清單中包含了：
blocks.en: Of particular note, the list includes:

blocks.zh: Punch List（待辦清單）：施工中發現的缺失項目
blocks.en: Punch List: deficiencies found during construction

blocks.zh: Discrepancies（偏差）：測試中的偏差記錄
blocks.en: Discrepancies: records of deviations found during testing

blocks.zh: Turnover Packages（移交文件包）：正式的系統移交文件
blocks.en: Turnover Packages: the formal system handover documents

blocks.zh: 建議採用電子文件儲存
blocks.en: Electronic Document Storage Is Recommended

blocks.zh: ISPE 建議使用電子儲存（如 EDMS，電子文件管理系統）。但要注意：若使用電子系統，必須提前告知所有廠商和承包商，確保他們能以電子格式提交文件。
blocks.en: ISPE recommends electronic storage (such as an EDMS, electronic document management system). Note, however, that if an electronic system is used, all vendors and contractors must be told in advance so that they can submit documents in electronic format.

blocks.zh: 實務上，在 CDMO 的大型建設專案中，光是追蹤和管理廠商文件，就需要一個專職的文件控制工程師（Document Control Engineer）。
blocks.en: In practice, on a large CDMO construction project, tracking and managing vendor documents alone calls for a dedicated Document Control Engineer.

blocks.zh: 系統概述（System Overview）的作用
blocks.en: The Role of the System Overview

blocks.zh: 系統概述是一個高層次的系統描述，說明系統的功能、邊界（System Boundary）、及自動化方式。
blocks.en: The System Overview is a high-level description of the system that explains its function, the System Boundary, and its means of automation.

blocks.zh: 它可以標示在：
blocks.en: It can be shown in:

blocks.zh: 文字說明中
blocks.en: A written description

blocks.zh: P&ID（管道與儀表圖）上劃定範圍
blocks.en: A scope drawn on the P&ID (piping and instrumentation diagram)

blocks.zh: 系統圖紙上標示邊界
blocks.en: Boundaries marked on system drawings

blocks.zh: 早期定義系統邊界，是確保後續 IQ/OQ/PQ 不會「有漏網之魚」或「測試範疇過大」的關鍵。
blocks.en: Defining the system boundary early is the key to making sure later IQ/OQ/PQ neither lets anything slip through the net nor tests more than the scope requires.

blocks.zh: 委試文件用於確效的必要條件
blocks.en: Prerequisites for Using Commissioning Documents for Qualification

blocks.zh: 若委試文件要用來支援確效結論，ISPE 強調：
blocks.en: If commissioning documents are to be used to support qualification conclusions, ISPE emphasizes:

blocks.zh: 確效負責人和品質部門必須從計畫階段就參與委試活動的規劃與協調
blocks.en: The person responsible for qualification and the Quality Unit must be involved in planning and coordinating commissioning activities from the planning stage

blocks.zh: 需要定期召開委試計畫與進度會議
blocks.en: Regular commissioning planning and progress meetings are needed

blocks.zh: 這是因為委試文件的品質（格式、接受標準、審批程序）必須符合確效要求，而這只能在事前約定，不能事後補救。
blocks.en: This is because the quality of commissioning documents (format, acceptance criteria, approval procedures) must meet qualification requirements, and this can only be agreed in advance, not fixed afterwards.

blocks.zh: 差異處理程序（Discrepancy Handling）
blocks.en: Discrepancy Handling

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 必須預先定義：當測試結果不符合期望或接受標準時，應遵循的處理步驟。
blocks.en: The C&Q Plan must define in advance the steps to follow when test results do not meet expectations or acceptance criteria.

blocks.zh: 這個「差異處理程序（Discrepancy Handling Procedure）」必須在執行前就寫好（predefined），而不是等到出現偏差才臨時決定怎麼做。詳見 Section 7.4。
blocks.en: This Discrepancy Handling Procedure must be written before execution (predefined), rather than decided on the spot after a deviation occurs. See Section 7.4 for details.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：Pre-Approver vs Post-Approver
blocks.en: Key Term: Pre-Approver vs Post-Approver

blocks.zh: 事前審批者（Pre-Approver）：在文件執行或發放之前完成審批。確保計畫合理、標準正確、執行前已獲授權。
blocks.en: Pre-Approver: approves a document before it is executed or issued. Ensures that the plan is sound, the criteria are correct, and execution is authorized.

blocks.zh: 事後審批者（Post-Approver）：在文件執行完成後審批。確認結果符合要求、偏差已處理、可以接受結論。
blocks.en: Post-Approver: approves a document after execution is complete. Confirms that the results meet requirements, deviations have been handled, and the conclusions can be accepted.

blocks.zh: 最嚴格的文件（如確效測試文件）同時需要事前和事後審批，代表「執行前批准計畫，執行後批准結果」。
blocks.en: The most stringent documents (such as qualification test documents) require both pre-approval and post-approval, meaning "approve the plan before execution, and approve the results after execution".

blocks.zh: 核准矩陣的三個角色
blocks.en: The Three Roles in the Approval Matrix

blocks.zh: Quality Unit（品質部門）：負責確保法規符合性和品質標準
blocks.en: Quality Unit: responsible for ensuring regulatory compliance and quality standards

blocks.zh: Production User（生產用戶）：確保系統符合操作需求
blocks.en: Production User: ensures the system meets operational needs

blocks.zh: Technical1（技術）：包含工程、製程、SME（學科專家）；同一學科只需一個簽名
blocks.en: Technical1: includes engineering, process, and SMEs (subject matter experts); only one signature per discipline is needed

blocks.zh: Table 6.1 重要觀察
blocks.en: Key Observations on Table 6.1

blocks.zh: 1. 確效測試文件最嚴格：IQ/OQ/PQ 文件同時需要所有三方（QA、User、Technical）的事前和事後審批，顯示其最高的法規重要性。
blocks.en: 1. Qualification test documents are the most stringent: IQ/OQ/PQ documents require both pre-approval and post-approval from all three parties (QA, User, Technical), reflecting their highest regulatory importance.

blocks.zh: 2. C&Q Plan 只需事前審批：計畫文件只有「事前」審批，完成後不需要再次審批（因為計畫本身是用來指導後續工作的，不是「結果文件」）。
blocks.en: 2. The C&Q Plan needs pre-approval only: the plan has only "pre" approval and does not need to be approved again on completion (because the plan itself guides subsequent work and is not a "results document").

blocks.zh: 3. 追溯矩陣不需要正式審批：Traceability Matrix 的核准欄位全部是 "Not applicable"，因為它是技術部門內部使用的追蹤工具。
blocks.en: 3. The traceability matrix does not need formal approval: all approval fields for the Traceability Matrix are "Not applicable", because it is a tracking tool used internally by the technical function.

blocks.zh: 4. 品保對 URS 的審批有條件性（注2）：若品保已批准過 URS 的來源文件（如品質需求文件），則 URS 本身可不需品保二次審批。
blocks.en: 4. QA approval of the URS is conditional (Note 2): if QA has already approved the source documents of the URS (such as a quality requirements document), the URS itself need not be approved by QA a second time.

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語：Traceability Matrix（追溯矩陣）
blocks.en: Key Term: Traceability Matrix

blocks.zh: 追溯矩陣是一份文件，將每個 URS 需求項目，追溯到對應的設計文件、風險評估、測試項目，和測試結果。
blocks.en: A traceability matrix is a document that traces each URS requirement to the corresponding design documents, risk assessments, test items, and test results.

blocks.zh: 它回答了「我的每一個使用者需求，是否都有對應的測試驗證？」這個問題。Table 6.1 顯示它不需要正式的 Pre/Post-Approval，由 Technical 負責製作即可。
blocks.en: It answers the question "Is each of my user requirements verified by a corresponding test?" Table 6.1 shows that it does not need formal Pre/Post-Approval and can simply be produced by Technical.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務：如何使用核准矩陣
blocks.en: CDMO Practice: How to Use the Approval Matrix

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 的品保部門而言，Table 6.1 提供了一個最低限度的參考架構。實際操作時：
blocks.en: For the QA department of a CDMO, Table 6.1 provides a minimum reference framework. In practice:

blocks.zh: 公司 SOP 可以比 Table 6.1 要求更嚴格（增加更多審批者），但不應比它寬鬆
blocks.en: Company SOPs may be stricter than Table 6.1 (adding more approvers), but should not be looser

blocks.zh: 稽查時，稽查員可能要求展示核准矩陣，並驗證實際簽名記錄是否符合
blocks.en: During an inspection, the inspector may ask to see the approval matrix and verify that the actual signature records conform to it

blocks.zh: 若某文件缺少 Pre-Approval 就已執行，屬於重大程序違規（Protocol executed without prior approval）
blocks.en: If a document is executed without Pre-Approval, it is a serious procedural violation (protocol executed without prior approval)

blocks.zh: 建議在新專案啟動時，以 Table 6.1 為基礎，製作公司特定的核准矩陣
blocks.en: At the start of a new project, it is advisable to build a company-specific approval matrix based on Table 6.1

blocks.zh: 本章重點摘要 (Chapter Summary)
blocks.en: Chapter Summary

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 是專案的核心治理文件，定義範疇、策略、文件要求、角色責任，和測試方法。
blocks.en: The C&Q Plan is the core governance document of the project, defining the scope, strategy, document requirements, roles and responsibilities, and test approach.

blocks.zh: 審批時序規則：C&Q Plan 核准 → 測試指令核准 → 開始執行。此順序在業界常被違反，但稽查時後果嚴重。
blocks.en: Approval sequence rule: C&Q Plan approved → test instructions approved → execution begins. This order is often violated in industry, but the consequences in an inspection are serious.

blocks.zh: 計畫深度應與風險成比例：簡單變更納入變更管制即可；複雜系統（填充線、公用系統擴建）需要獨立的正式 C&Q Plan。
blocks.en: Plan depth should be proportionate to risk: simple changes can be covered by change control; complex systems (filling lines, utility expansions) need a standalone formal C&Q Plan.

blocks.zh: C&Q Plan 是活文件：隨專案進展更新；輕微偏離可記錄在 Qualification Summary Report 中，不必每次修訂計畫。
blocks.en: The C&Q Plan is a living document: it is updated as the project progresses; minor deviations can be recorded in the Qualification Summary Report, so the plan need not be revised every time.

blocks.zh: Document Matrix（文件矩陣）是管理所有文件進度的最有效工具。
blocks.en: The Document Matrix is the most effective tool for managing the progress of all documents.

blocks.zh: Turnover Package（移交文件包）是 IQ 的重要輸入，必須在確效開始前完成。
blocks.en: The Turnover Package is an important input to IQ and must be completed before qualification begins.

blocks.zh: Table 6.1 核准矩陣明確定義了每份文件的事前/事後審批者，是 CDMO 建立公司特定核准程序的最佳參考範本。
blocks.en: The Table 6.1 approval matrix clearly defines the pre-approvers and post-approvers of each document, and is the best reference template for a CDMO building its company-specific approval procedure.

blocks.zh: 確效測試文件是唯一同時需要所有三方（QA、User、Technical）事前和事後審批的文件。
blocks.en: Qualification test documents are the only documents that require both pre-approval and post-approval from all three parties (QA, User, Technical).
